headline: DRONE 🍆 SLAMS Kyiv 🏙️ BRIDGE as German Daddy 🧔 Visits
text:
KYIV 🏙️ BRIDGE 🌉 just got absolutely POUNDED 💥 by a RUSSIAN 🇷🇺 drone 🚁 while cars 🚗 were still zooming 🏎️ across it creating a MASSIVE 🔥 fireball 🌋 that lit up the whole sky ☀️!! Footage 📹 verified by the BBC 📺 shows the Pivnichyi Northern 🧭 Bridge getting slammed 🥊 for the SECOND 🥈 day in a row with two 👥 people injured 😣 as Moscow 🪆 ramps up attacks on critical 🏗️ infrastructure in Ukraine's capital 🏛️. Major bridges 🌉 in Kyiv have now been HIT 🎯 for four consecutive days straight as the Kremlin keeps edging 😩 this full scale invasion 🔥!! "To get from the left bank to the right one and back it's just HELL 😈" said local resident Roman 🧔‍♂️ while repair crews 🛠️ scramble to fix gaping holes 🕳️ in the traffic lanes.

The latest strike 🛠️ came exactly as German Chancellor Friedrich Merz 🧔‍♂️ made a surprise pop-up visit to Kyiv in a show of SOLIDARITY 🤝 against Russia's continuing full-scale invasion 🪖. Russia's military said they would be INTENSIFYING 🔥 strikes on Kyiv and other Ukrainian regions after claiming they successfully hit the two bridges used to transfer Ukrainian troops 🪖. The strike left a gaping hole 🕳️ right in the middle of a traffic lane on the bridge 🌉 while video 📽️ shows cars 🚗 moving normally before the drone 🚁 crashes and explodes 💥 sending a huge cloud ☁️ of black smoke rising above everything!! Kyiv Mayor Vitali Klitschko 👨‍💼 confirmed two people were injured and that the Pivnichnyi Bridge's roadway took the direct hit 🎯.

Kyiv's eight bridges 🌉 across the wide Dnipro River connect the western right bank and eastern left bank with many of the capital's three million residents relying on metro 🚇 lines and trains to get around the city daily. Some 500000 vehicles 🚗 use those bridges every single day yet the two struck bridges are still standing although the damage and restrictions have caused massive gridlock 🚦 in parts of the capital at times!! Repair teams 🧰 are working nonstop to fix the damage while officials announce plans for temporary pontoon bridges ⛴️ ferry services and even a tunnel under the river to keep Kyiv fully connected 🌉. Klitschko also revealed a separate Russian drone strike damaged a heating main 🧱 leaving a temporary lack of hot water 🔥 in the north-eastern Desnyanskyi district for residents.

Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy 🇺🇦 said Russian drones had also attacked a warehouse in the north-eastern Sumy region killing one person while in the central city of Dnipro six people were injured after a communications facility was struck 📡. Ukraine's Air Force reported that overnight Russia launched 135 drones including 52 jet-powered ones with 125 projectiles successfully shot down ✈️!! As emergency services 🛟 responded to the incidents Germany's Merz met Zelenskyy in Kyiv where they laid wreaths 🌺 to Ukrainian soldiers who have been killed in the war. Merz reaffirmed his country's support writing on X that Ukraine is facing decisive weeks and that you can rely on us with Germany's security also depending on the outcome of this war.

Zelenskyy later announced that a new aid package worth more than 1.3 billion euros had been agreed with Germany including weapons that will help right now as well as support for the energy sector ahead of winter ❄️!! As Merz was visiting the Ukraine National Academy of Sciences building that was badly damaged by a Russian drone strike earlier this week fresh air alert sirens 🚨 were heard across the city. He joined Zelenskyy at a memorial to fallen Ukrainian soldiers while since becoming chancellor in May 2025 Germany has become the single largest donor to Ukraine. Merz stressed the country needs all our support in the coming weeks and if Russia is not stopped its war machine will sooner or later turn against us.

The Russian defence ministry said it would intensify strikes across Ukraine in response to Zelenskyy's comments about ramping up attacks on Russian oil refineries 🛢️. Russian President Vladimir Putin had earlier claimed his military was carrying out retaliatory attacks following Ukraine's strikes on Moscow's energy facilities even though the Kremlin started it first. Putin began the full-scale invasion of Ukraine in February 2022 and Moscow currently controls about 20 percent of Ukrainian territory. The Russian foreign ministry repeated a warning for foreign citizens including diplomats to leave Kyiv but the EU ambassador fired back that the EU Delegation is staying and threatening us will not stop Europe's support for Ukraine!! The German ambassador simply replied Amen we're staying too.
